gloss: to give in to temptation; to succumb to temptation

definitions.gloss: to give in to temptation; to succumb to temptation
definitions.explanation: To fail to resist a desire or attraction, despite knowing one should resist. Used for everyday temptations like food, shopping, and entertainment, as well as more serious moral failings.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}けてしまった。
examples.english: Even though I'm on a diet, I gave in to the temptation of cake.

examples.japanese: ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}けて、つい⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧すぎた。
examples.english: I succumbed to the temptation of the sale and accidentally bought too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}けてしまう⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{情|なさ}けない→情けない：03129_nasakenai⟧。
examples.english: I'm frustrated with myself for giving in to the temptation of games when I should be studying.

notes:
A set expression combining ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧ (temptation) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (particle) + ⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (to lose). The structure parallels other ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ expressions where one "loses" to a force or pressure.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The conjugation follows ⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (ichidan verb):
- {誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}けた — gave in to temptation (past)
- {誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}けない — not give in to temptation
- {誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}けてしまう — end up giving in to temptation (often with regret)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧{誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}ける — to give in to sweet temptation
- つい{誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}ける — to inadvertently succumb to temptation
- {誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}けそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to be about to give in to temptation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ — to resist temptation (the opposite)
- ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抗|あらが}う→抗う：09141_aragau⟧ — to fight against temptation (more literary)
- ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{屈|くっ}する→屈する：09142_kussuru⟧ — to yield to temptation (more formal)
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}できない→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧ — unable to resist (more general expression)
